title: Shadows refute the local converse
claim: (1) Shadows: if every system over M has full ranges and h is a surjection with h(M) contained in K, then in every system the product M x K has exactly M's constrained sets, so it composes like cycles whenever M does. (2) Lifts: if M contains every constant tuple and every identification of its positions leaving two or more distinct variables is constrained, then doubling a value a and removing (a, ..., a) keeps M's constrained sets in every system. (3) The local converse and the diagonal lemma are false: K4 = {(x,y,z) in {0,1,2,3}^3 : the readings mod 3 with 3 read as 2 sum to 0} minus (2,2,2), the product of x+y+z=0 over Z3 with 'not exactly two ones' (6 values) and a 4-variable product on 4 values are non-rectangular knots with no direct case whose laws compose all circuits like cycles. (4) Fibre distance: if a knot's fibre graph at e is connected with two fibres at distance at least 2, or at distance 1 with a value at distance at least 2 from a fibre, composing with the fibre-sharing relation gives a knot with pairwise meeting fibres and hence a failure; so in a law composing knots like cycles each fibre graph is disconnected or dense. Two values admit no counterexample; three values are open.
failure_conditions: A system over a shadow product, or over K4 or the GF(4) lift, has constrained sets different from M's or a failure between circuits.
A lift's pinned variable takes the doubled value, or an unpinned variable misses a value.
K6, K4 or K4x4 is rectangular, not a knot, has a direct case or a fibre-distance case, or a diagonal derivation of K6 or K4 has a direct case.
A fibre-distance composition is not a knot with pairwise meeting fibres, or its two copies do not fail.
The single-sorted product of parity with the neither-knot has no failure, or a positional parity system has a constant variable or differs from the product.
A recorded census-candidate failure does not verify.
foundation_claim_scope: Which algebraic properties of a law's knots follow from its knots composing like cycles. No native recurrence, composed topology in the protected sense, path, metric distance or physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies the shadow theorem on two named products (400 systems each) and 9 random shadows (900 systems), the lift theorem on K4 and a GF(4) lift (500 systems each, including pinned ranges), the counterexamples' properties, the fibre-distance construction on 30 sparse knots, the full-range and identification hypotheses, the census candidates, and agreement with the census; five controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; builds on KNOT-CIRCUITS-20261020-001B-P001 and MALTSEV-CONVERSE-20261020-001B-P001; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: elementary; the product and lift constructions and the fibre-distance construction are new to the program, whose notion of constrained sets relative to ranges is its own; no literature search beyond the circuits proof's sources.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-21.
